bio_50_words: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Sherine El-Said El-Khouly is Director of the Medicine and Surgery Program at East Port Said National University. She leads efforts to align medical training and learning outcomes with healthcare needs, supervises student research and community medical convoys, and holds an Excellent-graded professional diploma from Egypt's GAHAR healthcare accreditation authority.

disambiguation_notes: No external academic profile (Google Scholar, ResearchGate, ORCID, Scopus, PSU staff page, EKB) could be matched to her. Searches by WebSearch (English and Arabic) found only the EPNU page. OpenAlex 'Khouly' authors with first name Sher*: Sherif El-Khouly, Sherief Elkhouly (Mansoura, ophthalmology), Sherif El Khouly: all male, rejected. PubMed 'El-Khouly SE'/'El-Khouly S' (ophthalmology/orbital MRI, 2010-2019) and 'Elkhouly SH' (geophysics/chemistry): rejected, no Port Said affiliation and no link to her; likely other people (SE could be Sherief Elkhouly, Mansoura). Not merged. Her Facebook/EPNU Arabic posts name her only as 'Dr. Sherine El-Khouly'. Name variants in EPNU sources: Sherine El-Khouly, Shereen El Khouly. Weak hint only: post 4574 shows the Faculty attends Port Said Society of Internal Medicine conference under her supervision; this does NOT establish internal medicine as her specialty. Suggest asking EPNU HR/IR for her CV.
